title: Safety and Driving Systems
summary: Feedback centers on safety technology, driving systems, and related usability, with clear praise for capability but many fragments too brief to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise strong safety features, modern driver-assistance technology, comfort-related safety benefits, and good drivability.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize awkward IT system usability and disappointment with infotainment, navigation, and phone-related systems.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention safety systems, comfort, or drivability without enough context to tell whether the comments are favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are short or incomplete, which limits sentiment interpretation.
The topic combines safety systems, drivability, and broader in-car technology, so some examples are only loosely connected.
Examples are stratified samples and do not represent the full set of reviews.
